description_en: Applies for a public endpoint for an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于为RDS实例申请外网连接地址
kebab_example: aliyun rds allocate-instance-public-connection --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --connection-string-prefix test1234 --port 3306 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AllocateInstancePublicConnection

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The prefix of the public endpoint. The complete public endpoint is in the format of `prefix.engine.rds.aliyuncs.com`. Example: `test1234.mysql.rds.aliyuncs.com`.

The prefix must be 5 to 40 characters in length and cannot contain Chinese characters or special characters (~!#%^&*=+|{};:'",<>/?). The prefix can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
外网连接地址的前缀。完整外网连接地址为：`前缀.引擎名.rds.aliyuncs.com`。例如`test1234.mysql.rds.aliyuncs.com`。

长度5\~40，不能包含汉字和非法字符（\~!#%^&*=+|{};:'",<>/?），建议由字母、数字、短横线（-）组成
parameters.name: connection_string_prefix

parameters.help_en: The public port. Valid values: 1000 to 5999
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en:
The TDS port number of Babelfish for RDS PostgreSQL.
This parameter is applicable only to ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances. For more information about Babelfish for RDS PostgreSQL, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428613.html
parameters.help_zh:
Babelfish for RDS PostgreSQL TDS端口号。
该参数仅适用于RDS PostgreSQL实例，Babelfish for RDS PostgreSQL的更多介绍，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428613.html
parameters.name: babelfish_port

parameters.help_en: The name of the dedicated cluster group to which the general-purpose ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 专属集群MySQL通用版实例所属的组名
parameters.name: general_group_name

parameters.help_zh:
PgBouncer端口。
该参数仅支持PostgreSQL实例
parameters.name: pg_bouncer_port
